## Description
Summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature / Expert production rule
- [ ] Performance optimization / Refactor
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project
- [ ] I have verified that no external LLM API dependencies have been introduced
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix or feature works
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`python -m unittest discover tests`)
- [ ] The frontend builds without errors (`npm run build` in `frontend/`)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly
